result.summary: The page appears mostly well-designed with clear navigation and content. However, there is a minor layout issue where the last visible restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza image) is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, making it look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding or margin at the bottom of the scrollable area so that the last card is fully visible before the navigation bar.
